client.business_model: Multi-site women's healthcare platform that operates OB-GYN, primary care and related specialty clinics across several U.S. states with both in-person and telehealth services.
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has expanded rapidly through acquisitions—most notably the 2019 purchase of Heartland Women’s Healthcare—and the launch of its flagship ‘Liv by Advantia Health’ clinic in Washington, D.C., positioning itself as a leading integrated women’s health provider in the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest.

revenue.source: Buzzfile company profile (approx. $29.1 M annual revenue)
revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates vary widely: Zippia $13 M (2024), Growjo $22.4 M, Buzzfile $29.1 M, CanvasBusinessModel $89 M. No official filing or press release was found. Using Buzzfile figure as midpoint but treating with low confidence.

locations.source: craft.co locations page and specific clinic addresses listed in web search results
locations.notes: 27 distinct clinic addresses were enumerated across MD, VA, DC, IL and MO. Company press releases indicate additional sites (e.g., Heartland Women’s Healthcare adds 25 locations) but a precise total is not published on the public website.

employees.source: Zippia company profile (750 employees, 2024); corroborated by Indeed and SignalHire ranges of 500-1,000 employees
employees.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size band as 501-1,000, consistent with Zippia’s 750 figure. Buzzfile lists 259 which appears understated, so 750 is used.
